title: PDF Builder
description: Drag-and-drop PDF editor with AI form generation — describe a form in plain text and Claude generates the fields, layout, and pre-filled values via structured prompt engineering.

title: Scribbler 2026
description: Collaborative writing platform for organising work into collections and articles — distraction-free rich-text editing, writer profiles, an activity feed, and messaging between collaborators.

title: Chatty Prayers — AI Debates, and Counsel
description: Personality-driven AI platform with one-on-one chat, confidant reflection, and structured multi-participant debate — built with Blazor and the Claude and Gemini APIs.

title: Panic Stations
description: Turn-based sci-fi roguelike RPG built with React Native and Expo — procedurally generated space stations, tap-to-move pathfinding, and fog-of-war exploration.

title: ZOME — Spatial Messenger
description: ZOME is a spatial platform and messenger where you can plant your messages anywhere in the world, at any location and even points in time.

title: JobFit™ — AI Job Match Analyser
description: AI-powered tool that scores a CV against a job description, surfaces skill gaps, and drafts a cover letter.

title: Spatial UI Components
description: A library of reusable spatial UI components for Apple Vision Pro using RealityKit and SwiftUI.

title: Search in Robotic Task Planning
description: Academic research into heuristic search and efficiency for algorithms applied to autonomous robotic task planning.

title: ChattyPrayers.Api
description: ASP.NET Core API powering streaming chat, multi-participant AI debate, SVG generation, and RAG-based conversation search via Ollama embeddings.

title: MarkdownForms.Api
description: A .NET API that renders and processes dynamic form schemas defined in Markdown — PDF export with AcroForm generation and AI-assisted field population.
